label.$catatan_detail: Label detail kondisi per kategori. Dipakai untuk draf deskripsi otomatis (docs/AI.md § Draf deskripsi). 'kalimat' adalah teks Indonesia yang ditampilkan; tidak ada angka agar draf tidak pernah mengarang ukuran.

drainase.prompt: a photo of a drainage ditch clogged with plastic trash
a photo of a drainage channel filled with mud and sediment
a photo of drainage water overflowing onto the street
a photo of a broken or missing drain cover on a sidewalk

banjir.prompt: a photo of floodwater covering a road
a photo of floodwater entering houses
banjir.kalimat: Air banjir masuk ke rumah warga

banjir.prompt: a photo of vehicles struggling through a flooded street
a photo of muddy brown floodwater in a neighborhood

jalan.prompt: a photo of a deep pothole in an asphalt road
a photo of cracked and peeling asphalt
a photo of potholes filled with rainwater
jalan.kalimat: Lubang jalan tergenang air sehingga sulit terlihat

jalan.prompt: a photo of a collapsed road edge

longsor.prompt: a photo of landslide soil and rocks covering a road
a photo of a cracked hillside slope at risk of collapsing
longsor.kalimat: Tebing retak dan berpotensi longsor susulan

longsor.prompt: a photo of a landslide next to houses
a photo of trees fallen due to a landslide

lainnya.prompt: a photo of a broken street light
a photo of a damaged small bridge or railing
a photo of a broken sidewalk
a photo of a damaged public building

drainase.beres: a photo of a clean, clear drainage ditch
drainase.belum: a photo of a clogged drainage ditch full of trash

banjir.beres: a photo of a dry street
banjir.belum: a photo of a flooded street

jalan.beres: a photo of a smooth, freshly paved road
jalan.belum: a photo of a damaged road with potholes

longsor.beres: a photo of a reinforced, cleared slope
longsor.belum: a photo of a landslide blocking the road

lainnya.belum: a photo of a broken public facility

prompt.sistem: Kamu analis kebijakan publik. Tulis ringkasan 2-3 kalimat dalam Bahasa Indonesia untuk pejabat daerah. Salin angka PERSIS seperti tertulis di fakta. DILARANG menghitung, mengurangkan, atau menyimpulkan angka baru (misalnya persen sisa). Jangan menambah fakta. Akhiri dengan satu rekomendasi tindakan untuk wilayah yang disebut.
